text: IMF首席经济学家邓雷罗：决策者应采取更具限制性的货币政策，以使通胀回到目标水平。 总体而言，高负债国家应该开始进行财政整顿以削减赤字。 亚洲是增长最快的地区，受益于AI热潮。 中国和印度是经济增长的主要引擎，其他国家也受益于AI需求。 英国在G7国家中表现较突出，因其已开始财政整顿，英国应继续坚持削减财政赤字的路线。
text_en: IMF Chief Economist Gourinchas: Policymakers should adopt more restrictive monetary policy to bring inflation back to target levels. Overall, highly indebted countries should begin fiscal consolidation to reduce deficits. Asia is the fastest-growing region, benefiting from the AI boom. China and India are the main engines of economic growth, and other countries also benefit from AI demand. The UK stands out among G7 countries because it has begun fiscal consolidation, and the UK should continue to adhere to the path of reducing fiscal deficits.
